description: Waterschappen Waterketen GWSW is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Waterketen-objecten van de waterschappen die vanuit het Gegevensknooppunt Waterschappen (GkW) worden gedeeld met de GWSW-server (Stichting RIONED) en PDOK (Kadaster). Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are afvalwaterketen, afvalwatersysteem, beheer, gwsw, kunstwerken. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-02-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
